blocking_gaps.expected: Orchestrator restart must recover queued task state from durable storage and avoid duplicate activation.
blocking_gaps.observed: Queue/running/circuit state are process-memory only and are lost on restart.

blocking_gaps.expected: Circuit breaker must trip on timeout-rate degradation.
blocking_gaps.observed: Lane timeout is handled outside GraphService, so breaker timeout-rate logic is not fed by real lane timeouts.

findings.title: Concurrent duplicate consumption can execute the same idempotency key multiple times
findings.issue: The service checks terminal state and increments attempts before any in-flight lock, then awaits I/O. Parallel deliveries of the same event can both proceed into build execution.
findings.impact: Duplicate index builds, inconsistent attempts accounting, and non-deterministic retry/DLQ behavior under concurrent delivery.
findings.suggested_fix: Add per-idempotency in-flight deduplication (promise lock) and enforce durable idempotency with a DB uniqueness boundary (insert-if-not-exists on idempotency key).

findings.title: Orchestrator queue/circuit state is not recoverable after process restart
findings.issue: Queued tasks, running state, and datasource circuit-open windows are held only in memory; no persistence or startup rehydration exists.
findings.impact: Node restart can drop queued tasks and reset failure isolation, violating recovery expectations and causing silent work loss.
findings.suggested_fix: Persist orchestrator task state and breaker metadata in storage, then reload and resume on bootstrap with idempotent task dispatch.

findings.title: Retry/DLQ state is memory-only and unbounded in event consumer
findings.issue: attemptsByIdempotency/terminalResultsByIdempotency are process-local maps with no TTL or persistence.
findings.impact: After restart, retry/DLQ progression resets; over time, key cardinality can cause memory growth and eventual pressure/OOM.
findings.suggested_fix: Move attempts/terminal state to durable storage with retention policy; apply bounded cache (TTL/LRU) only as read-through optimization.

findings.title: Post-activation replay write failures incorrectly fail the whole build job
findings.issue: After buildAndActivate succeeds, replay writes are still in the main try-block; telemetry write failure enters catch and rethrows as build failure.
findings.impact: Callers may retry successful activations, creating duplicate churn and false failure signals while active index has already advanced.
findings.suggested_fix: Split critical activation from best-effort telemetry. Do not rethrow telemetry-only failures; emit degraded observability event and continue.

findings.title: Lane timeout does not cancel underlying work and does not contribute to graph breaker timeout-rate
findings.issue: Promise.race timeout returns degraded lane result, but the underlying lane task is not cancelled. Also GraphService timeout-rate breaker logic only updates when GraphAccelerationTimeoutError is thrown internally, not when retrieval-level lane timeout fires.
findings.impact: Timed-out work can continue consuming resources; repeated latency timeouts may never trip timeout-rate breaker, reducing protective effectiveness.
findings.suggested_fix: Introduce AbortController propagation through lane executors/adapters and record timeout signals into GraphAccelerationCircuitBreaker when retrieval-level timeout occurs.

findings.title: R6 gate can fail-open due synthetic/hardcoded reliability metrics
findings.issue: indexBuildSuccessRate is derived from isolation violations rather than actual build success/failure, and staleCacheReadRate/graphFallbackActivationRate/securityGatePass are hardcoded (0/0/true).
findings.impact: Release gate may report healthy when core reliability controls are degraded or failing.
findings.suggested_fix: Source each metric from real telemetry counters; if metric pipeline is unavailable, mark as insufficient_samples or unknown and block pass.

findings.title: Cache memory can grow without effective upper bound
findings.issue: L1/L2 maps have no max-size policy. Expired keys are evicted only on read-path checks, so cold expired keys may accumulate indefinitely.
findings.impact: High-cardinality traffic can cause steady memory growth and unstable latency due GC pressure.
findings.suggested_fix: Add bounded cache policy (max entries/bytes + proactive sweep) and eviction telemetry; include jittered TTL to avoid synchronized expiry spikes.

testing_gaps: No test simulates orchestrator process restart with persisted queue/task recovery (required by R6 Unit 1).
No test verifies retrieval-level lane timeout increments graph breaker timeout-rate and eventually opens breaker.
No test covers replay write failure after successful index activation to ensure no false build failure is propagated.
